title: Grilled kippers with spring onion butter

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Kippers, butter, bread, watercress and herbs are all plain foods a grandparent would have had in the kitchen.

supermarket.reason: Kipper fillets, watercress, spring onions and wholemeal bread are everyday Tesco items at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only a grill pan, small bowl and toaster are needed, and the technique is simple mashing and grilling.

works.reason: Four kipper fillets grilled for 4 to 5 minutes on toast with a flavoured butter makes a sound breakfast for four, and the kippers bring their own salt.

honest_times.reason: Slicing spring onions, chopping parsley and zesting a lemon fits in 10 minutes, and the 5 minute grill matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon for zest and wedges, is used, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A whole bunch of spring onions goes into the named butter that flavours both the kippers and the toast, which suits a cool March morning.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, with no fuss or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish on wholemeal toast with watercress is a proper, nourishing breakfast a family would happily repeat.
